positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Redwood City, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Developed Oracle’s new source control management system built in Java on JGit and OCI.
- Lead the migration of Oracle’s repositories to OCI’s new SCM system.
- Implemented a distributed system to continuously migrate Git repositories daily.
- Implemented backend features and internal APIs for user's migration experience.
- Wrote Python scripts to pull metrics and generate reports on migration. Reporting weekly to management.
- Rotated on-call, performed analysis on service metrics, proactively mitigated issues, and improved on-call tooling.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Programming · Software Deployment · REST APIs · Data Analysis · Python (Programming Language) · Java · Algorithms · Docker · Cloud Computing · SQL · Software Infrastructure · OCI

positions.title: Director and Committee Chair
positions.locationName: New Brunswick, New Jersey, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Served as technical lead for a team of undergraduate developers to build an application used daily by lab workers to validate outputs from a YOLO object detection model. The system processed 100,000+ railway object detection events, identifying anomalies and validating video data for intersection design.
    - Designed and implemented a multi-processing workflow manager in Python to run an ensemble of computer vision models to label different object detection anomalies outputted by the Y.O.L.O. model.
    - Collaborated with and mentored other students on models built with OpenCV, Scikit, and PyTorch.
    - Dockerized and deployed backend and frontend services, managed a PostgreSQL database on AWS.
- Designed and implemented a user interface using Javascript, React, and Node.js to manage computer vision model workflows and streamline the manual validation of video data.
positions.insights: Skills: PyTorch · Node.js · Computer Vision · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python (Programming Language) · React.js · Machine Learning · HTML · Scikit-Learn · Express.js · Full-Stack Development · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern - OCI Compute
positions.description: - Designed and implemented an automated data collection system in Python to monitor virtual machine usage by compiling and analyzing data from multiple telemetry APIs to create a central source for efficiency initiatives.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Docker · Unix · REST APIs · Software Development

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern - OCI Console
positions.description:

- Extended event-based data-tracking to support more robust AB-Testing.

projects.title: Snail Measurement Tool
projects.description: Developed a Java application using OpenCV for Civitello Research Lab at Emory University. The application measures the size of snails in a series of images, accelerating data collection by 900% while improving accuracy. Co-authoring journal article with lab’s lead investigator.

projects.title: Epidem.io
projects.description: A web-based virus survival game developed using TypeScript, PIXI.js, Express.js and socket.io.  The game supports up to 75 players along with dozens of AI characters in each round.
